engineering_notes: Initial VHD export sharing violation retained; one retry after observed stopped state and documented format syntax succeeded.
WSL --help returned 4294967295 despite providing help. An early check_output call treated this as a fatal read-only tooling error; subsequent capture preserved its exit code and useful output.

An upstream-runtime directory regex omitted the leading 3. in 3.0.20260805.254768; the resulting metadata request returned HTTP 404. The actual directory link was then inspected and pinned before downloading or executing that runtime.
Windows Python warned about a malformed certificate in the local certificate store during upstream reads; TLS verification was not disabled. Downloads used verified artifact hashes.
An early nested PowerShell metadata query produced no displayed record; a direct read-only query subsequently captured system cmd file version, hash and valid signature.
A documentation patch failed to match its context; no files changed in that failed operation.

Initial Proton stdout was absent for all three operations. Pinned launcher source distinguished Unix helper and DOS direct paths. One preregistered capture-method repetition used unchanged probes and a fresh prefix; initial sequence remains INCONCLUSIVE.
UMU package setup reported systemd/bus unavailable despite exit 0. Proton createprefix intentionally returned 1 for its empty executable; all setup diagnostics are retained.

A private-hostname scan failed before an own local checkpoint, but a subsequent successful git diff masked the shell exit status and the checkpoint proceeded. It was never pushed. A private verified bundle preceded deterministic redaction and repair of that unpublished checkpoint. Validation commands now propagate failures explicitly.

Git attempted to normalise Win32 CRLF stdout. A directory-scoped -text attribute now preserves capture bytes; all original global attributes were retained after correcting an intermediate local attribute-file replacement.
A registry metadata filter captured many generic Version fields in addition to Windows identity. The overbroad evidence is retained; it is not treated as extra capability testing.
Host display APIs reported different resolutions. Both records are retained; Wine/WSLg presentation scaling was not validated.

Final staged-byte validation detected six vanilla/staging stdout blobs still normalized to LF in checkpoint 273509d4bc551666e66902e47e535d3c2444de96. Their retained working bytes matched the original CRLF capture hashes. A scoped git add --renormalize restored those bytes; artifact-manifest.json records both checkpoint and raw/final identities. No experiment was rerun and the checkpoint remains in history.
manual_analysis_required: Agent inspected raw stdout/stderr, control semantics, UMU/Proton source routing, source/artifact hashes, package differences, privacy fields and final reports. Independent owner review remains outstanding.
